## CD4 set up

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r set up}
set.seed(42)
library(Seurat)
library(ggpubr)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(scCustomize)
library(scRepertoire)
library(scCustomize)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(stringr)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

T4 <- readRDS("~/R/T4.harmony.rds")

T4tum <- subset(T4, subset = tissue == "tumor")
T4LN <- subset(T4, subset = tissue == "LN")

T4shared <- subset(T4, subset = overlap_2 == "Y")
T4locexp <- subset(T4, subset = overlap_2 == "N" & Frequency_2 >1)


col_T4 <- c(
  
  "Tcentral mem(1)"="#E49C85",
  "Tcentral mem(2)"="#BFA38B",
  "Tearly act"="#EDC7A9",
  "Tcytotox(1)"="#B5728A",
  "Tcytotox(2)"="#933B5B",
  "Tcytotox(3)"="#7D314C",
  "T HSP" = "#EC6159",
  "CD4-CD8 mix" = "#BB535B",
  "Treg(1)"="#EA8CAA",
  "Treg(2)"="#8A6994",
  "Texh-like"="#E83D66",
  "Tfh"="#EF7D81")

colorblind_vector <- colorRampPalette(rev(c("#0D0887FF", # single
                                            "#7301A8FF", # small
                                            "#BD3786FF", # medium
                                            "#ED7953FF"))) # large
Tissue.Col = c(
  "LN" = '#00897b',
  "tumor" = "#B80219"
)

```

```{r}
DimPlot(T4, label =F, group.by = "cluster_annotation", cols = col_T4) + NoAxes()

```


## Fig 2B - heatmap with canonical markers

```{r heatmap} 
library(pheatmap)
allgenes <- c(
  "TCF", "SELL", "LEF1",
  "NOSIP", "GIMAP7", "LTB", "CCR7",
  "S100A4",
  "NR4A2", "ANXA1", "TNFAIP3", "CXCR4",
  "CCL5", "GZMA", "LGALS3", "IFNG",
  "GZMK", "NKG7", "GNLY",
  "NEAT1", 
  "HSPA1B", "HSPA1A", "EGR1", "TNFRSF4",
  "FOXP3", "TIGIT", "CTLA4", "IKZF2", "CD27", "IL2RB",
"DUSP4", "TNFRSF18","CXCR6",
  "TOX", "TOX2", "PDCD1", 
  "CXCL13",  "LAG3", "HAVCR2")

avg_expr <- AggregateExpression(object = T4, # condsider AverageExpression
                                group.by = "cluster_annotation") # change for annotation
avg_expr_matrix <- avg_expr$RNA
subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[rownames(avg_expr_matrix) %in% allgenes, ]

row_names <- rownames(avg_expr_matrix)

ordered_indices <- order(match(row_names, allgenes))

subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[ordered_indices, ]
subset_matrix <- subset_matrix[rownames(subset_matrix) %in% allgenes, ]

cal_z_score <- function(x){
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data_subset_norm <- t(apply(subset_matrix, 1, cal_z_score))

pheatmap(data_subset_norm,
         #color = hcl.colors(50, "RdGy", rev = T),
         #order_color = NA,
         #scale = "row",
         #cutree_rows = F,
         cellwidth = 12,
         #cellheight = 15,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F)
```


## Fig 2C1 - cluster distribution bar plot per patient
```{r}
md <- T4@meta.data
# create a table with cell counts per cluster per patient and tissue
cell_count <- unique(md$patient_true) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(patient_true == p) %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue, cluster_annotation) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })


# make a stacked bar chart of the frequency per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = patient_true, y = percentage, fill = cluster_annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_T4) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
    # title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "CD4 cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


## Barplot per tissue (on average)
## remove NAs (if patient_true = NA)
cell_count <- T4@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_true))

cell_count <- cell_count %>% 
  group_by(tissue, cluster_annotation) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())

cell_count <- cell_count %>% mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)


#rename LN to TDLN
cell_count$tissue[cell_count$tissue == "LN"] <- "TDLN"

# barplot distribution per tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = tissue, y = percentage, fill = cluster_annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5)+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_T4) +
  theme_classic()+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Cell Types")) + 
  ylab("percentage") +
  xlab("")+ 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1))

```

## Fig 2C1 - statistics on differences
```{r}
df2 = md %>%
  count(patient_true, tissue, cluster_annotation) %>%
  group_by(patient_true, tissue) %>%
  mutate(percent = prop.table(n) * 100) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(patient_true, "NA")) %>%
  ungroup()

statistics = df2 %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_true, cluster_annotation), names_from = tissue, values_from = percent) %>%
  group_by(cluster_annotation) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(LN, tumor, paired = TRUE)$p.value, 
            median_LN = median(LN, na.rm = TRUE), median_tumor = median(tumor, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
         signif = case_when(
           p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
           p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
           p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
           TRUE ~ ""
         ))

print(statistics)

```

## Fig 2D - volcano plot for Tregs
### LN vs tumor markers in Tregs (both Treg(1) and Treg(2) together)

```{r}
all_treg_cells = subset(T4, subset = cluster_annotation == c("Treg(1)","Treg(2)"))
dge_all_t_ln_vs_tumor = FindMarkers(all_treg_cells, ident.1 = "LN", ident.2 = "tumor", group.by = "tissue", min.pct = 0.25, logfc.treshold = 0.25)

labels <- rownames(dge_all_t_ln_vs_tumor)

# Remove these labels from being shown
labels[labels %in% c("MYADM", "ZNRF1", "DDIT", "PLIN2", "IER5")] <- ""


# add new labels
genes_to_label <- c(
  "JUND", "BATF", "ICOS", "NR4A2", "TNFRSF4",
  "JUNB", "TCF7", "TIGIT", "SOCS1",
  "DUSP4", "HSPA1B", "TNAIP3",
  "DNAJA1", "NKFBIA", "RGS", "JUN", 
  "BAG3", "EGR1",
  "HSPA8", "FOSB", "CTLA4", 
  "SELL", "IL16", "CCR7", "LEF1"
)

EnhancedVolcano(
  dge_all_t_ln_vs_tumor,
  lab = rownames(dge_all_t_ln_vs_tumor),
  selectLab = genes_to_label,
  x = "avg_log2FC",
  y = "p_val_adj",
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  arrowheads = FALSE,
  widthConnectors = 0.7,
  colConnectors = "black",
  typeConnectors = "closed",
  labSize = 5,
  lengthConnectors = unit(0.2, "npc")
) +
  ggtitle("all Tregs, TDLN vs. tumor")

```


## Fig 2E1 - clonal expansion in CD4 UMAP
```{r}
#remove cells without TCR/patient info)
T4dim <- subset(T4, subset =! is.na(T4@meta.data$cloneType_new))

DimPlot(T4, group.by = "cloneType_new",
        pt.size=0.5) +
        #split.by = "tissue") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorblind_vector(4), na.value="#e9e9e9") + 
  ggtitle("Clonal expansion in CD4") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank()) + 
  xlab('') +  ylab('') +
  NoAxes()
```

## Fig 2E2 - clone stacked bar plots per tissue 
```{r}
clonalOccupy(T4, 
             x.axis = "tissue") +ggtitle('CD4 clones') + ylim(0,4100) +

    "Single (0 < X <= 1)" = "#0D0887FF", # single
    "Small (1 < X <= 5)" =  "#7301A8FF", # small
    "Medium (5 < X <= 20)" = "#BD3786FF", # medium

  )
```

## Fig 2E3 - clone numbers in bar graphs
```{r}
df <- T4@meta.data %>%
  select(patient_true, tissue, Clonotype_patient, cloneType_new)

result <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_true)) %>%  # Remove rows with NA in patient_true
  group_by(tissue, cloneType_new) %>%
  summarise(unique_clones = n_distinct(Clonotype_patient), .groups = "drop") %>%  # Count unique clonotypes per tissue
  arrange( tissue, cloneType_new)  # Optional: sort for readability

# View result
View(result)
# write.csv(result, 'CD4.clonetype.per.tissue.csv')
```

## Fig 2G - absolute / relative distribution of shared vs locexp CD4 T cells per cluster
```{r}
col_overlap <- c("Y" = "#EC5E27", "N" = "#403D39", "NA" = "grey")

order <- c("Y", "N", "NA")

md <- T4@meta.data
# create a table with shared/locexp per cluster
cell_count <- unique(md$cluster_annotation) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(cluster_annotation == p) %>%
      group_by(cluster_annotation, overlap_2) %>% ## add tissue if split by tissue
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(cluster_annotation) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })

# make a stacked bar chart of the proportion per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = cluster_annotation, y = percentage, fill = factor(overlap_2, order))) + ## factor + order to adjust order
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_overlap) +
  # facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
    # title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "clonotype sharing"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Figure created in Graphpad
```



# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 2

## Fig S2A - dotplot met top 3 markers

```{r dotplot}
# Figure 5 Dotplot
DGE = FindAllMarkers(T4, only.pos = TRUE, logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25)
top3 = DGE %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n (n = 3, wt = avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

features_unique = unique(top3$gene)
DotPlot(T4, features = features_unique) + RotatedAxis()

```

## Fig S2E and Fig S2F - upset plot
```{r upset}

metadata <-  as.data.frame(T4@meta.data)
# Create a new data frame to store the binary values
binary_matrix <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(metadata), ncol = length(levels(metadata$cluster_annotation))))

# Set column names based on the levels of CD8.Cell.Types
colnames(binary_matrix) <- levels(metadata$cluster_annotation)

# Populate the binary matrix
for (i in 1:length(levels(metadata$cluster_annotation))) {
  binary_matrix[, i] <- metadata$cluster_annotation == levels(metadata$cluster_annotation)[i]
}

# Convert TRUE/FALSE to 1/0
binary_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(binary_matrix, as.integer))

# Add the binary matrix columns to the original metadata data frame
metadata <- cbind(metadata, binary_matrix)

# set CD8 Cell Types levels as cluster
cluster = c(levels(T4@meta.data$cluster_annotation))
# create table 'clones' with all labeled clones (Clonotype_2) with the distribution over the cell clusters 
clones <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(metadata$Clonotype_patient, metadata$cluster_annotation))
cluster = colnames(clones)


## locally expanded only
metadata2 <- metadata %>%
  filter(overlap_2== "N") %>%
  filter(Frequency_2>1)
clones <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(metadata2$Clonotype_patient, metadata2$cluster_annotation))
cluster = colnames(clones)

upset(clones, cluster, name='cluster', width_ratio=0.1,
      wrap = TRUE,
      n_intersections = 20) +   # top 20 van voorkomende intersections 
  ggtitle("Top 20 intersections of locally expanded clones")


## locally expanded only
metadata3 <- metadata %>%
  filter(overlap_2== "Y") %>%
  filter(Frequency_2>1)
clones <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(metadata3$Clonotype_patient, metadata3$cluster_annotation))
cluster = colnames(clones)

upset(clones, cluster, name='cluster', width_ratio=0.1,
      wrap = TRUE,
      n_intersections = 20) +   # top 20 van voorkomende intersections 
  ggtitle("Top 20 intersections of shared clones")
```
